newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chernogorneft 95 pretax profit 719 bln roubles.
newsitem.headline: Chernogorneft 95 pretax profit 719 bln roubles.

text.p: Russian oil producer AO Chernogorneft 0#CHGZ.RUO said on Thursday it achieved profit before tax of 719 billion roubles in 1995 after 871 billion roubles, adjusted for inflation, in 1994.
Using figures audited by Ernst & Young to U.S. GAAP, it said sales for 1995 were 2.5 trillion roubles, after 2.2 trillion roubles in 1994.
(all figures in billions of roubles, adjusted to December 31, 1995 value)

NOTES - Full name AOOT Chernogorneft. NK Sidanko owns 37.7 percent, and Uneximbank (Oneksimbank in Russian) and affiliates Bank ICFI (MFK Bank) and Moscow Partners own 17.3 percent. Another 14.9 percent of shares are held in American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) through Bank of New York, and 8.1 percent in Russian Depositary Receipts through ING Barings. Other foreign entities own 11.6 percent, with five foreign entities holding over one percent each, individual shareholders own 7.8 percent and other Russian entities 2.5 percent.
Shareholders equity at the end of 1995 was 3.176 trillion roubles. At the end of 1994 it was 2.651 trillion roubles, adjusted for inflation.

The Uneximbank group has control over Chernogorneft, as MFK Bank backed by Uneximbank won control of 51 percent of Sidanko under the government's shares-for-loans programme. Earlier this month Interros Oil acquired 34 percent of Sidanko at an investment tender. The Interros group includes Uneximbank and MFK Bank. Under the terms of the tender for Sidanko, the winner must transfer to Sidanko at least 13 percent of Chernogorneft.
